Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Round Battery Operated Vintage Decorative Wall Clock - 23 Inch, Black Wood
Colors: Black
Materials: hardwood
Along with telling you the time, this replica of a 1965 French clock is ready to add an artsy vintage touch to your wall. Beige accents against a black background give it a striking contrast that will be eye-catching in most any décor. 23.5" Diameter Hardwood clock face with iron hands Ready to hang, all hardware included
